verses.original: יְהוָ֣ה מָ֭לָךְ הָאָ֑רֶץ תָּגֵ֣ל רַבִּֽים׃ אִיִּ֥ים יִ֝שְׂמְח֗וּ
verses.transliteration: Yah·weh mā·lāḵ hā·’ā·reṣ tā·ḡêl rab·bîm ’î·yîm yiś·mə·ḥū
verses.literal: The LORD reigns let the earth rejoice let the distant shores be glad

verses.original: עָנָ֣ן וַעֲרָפֶ֣ל סְבִיבָ֑יו צֶ֥דֶק וּ֝מִשְׁפָּ֗ט כִּסְאֽוֹ׃ מְכ֣וֹן
verses.transliteration: ‘ā·nān wa·‘ă·rā·p̄el sə·ḇî·ḇāw ṣe·ḏeq ū·miš·pāṭ kis·’ōw mə·ḵō·wn
verses.literal: Clouds and darkness surround Him righteousness and justice are His throne’s foundation

verses.original: אֵ֭שׁ תֵּלֵ֑ךְ לְפָנָ֣יו וּתְלַהֵ֖ט צָרָֽיו׃ סָבִ֣יב
verses.literal: Fire goes before Him and consumes His foes on every side

verses.original: בְרָקָ֣יו הֵאִ֣ירוּ תֵּבֵ֑ל הָאָֽרֶץ׃ רָאֲתָ֖ה וַתָּחֵ֣ל
verses.transliteration: ḇə·rā·qāw hê·’î·rū tê·ḇêl hā·’ā·reṣ rā·’ă·ṯāh wat·tā·ḥêl
verses.literal: His lightning illuminates the world the earth sees and trembles

verses.original: הָרִ֗ים נָ֭מַסּוּ כַּדּוֹנַ֗ג מִלִּפְנֵ֣י יְהוָ֑ה מִ֝לִּפְנֵ֗י אֲד֣וֹן כָּל־ הָאָֽרֶץ׃
verses.transliteration: hā·rîm nā·mas·sū kad·dō·w·naḡ mil·lip̄·nê Yah·weh mil·lip̄·nê ’ă·ḏō·wn kāl- hā·’ā·reṣ
verses.literal: The mountains melt like wax at the presence of the LORD before the Lord of all the earth

verses.original: הַשָּׁמַ֣יִם הִגִּ֣ידוּ צִדְק֑וֹ כָל־ הָעַמִּ֣ים וְרָא֖וּ כְּבוֹדֽוֹ׃
verses.transliteration: haš·šā·ma·yim hig·gî·ḏū ṣiḏ·qōw ḵāl hā·‘am·mîm wə·rā·’ū kə·ḇō·w·ḏōw
verses.literal: The heavens proclaim His righteousness all the peoples see His glory

verses.original: כָּל־ עֹ֬בְדֵי פֶ֗סֶל יֵבֹ֤שׁוּ׀ הַמִּֽתְהַלְלִ֥ים בָּאֱלִילִ֑ים הִשְׁתַּחֲווּ־ ל֝וֹ כָּל־ אֱלֹהִֽים׃
verses.transliteration: kāl- ‘ō·ḇə·ḏê p̄e·sel yê·ḇō·šū ham·miṯ·hal·lîm bā·’ĕ·lî·lîm hiš·ta·ḥă·wū- lōw kāl- ’ĕ·lō·hîm
verses.literal: All worshipers of images are put to shame those who boast in idols Worship Him all [you] gods

verses.original: צִיּ֗וֹן שָׁמְעָ֬ה וַתִּשְׂמַ֨ח׀ בְּנ֣וֹת יְהוּדָ֑ה וַ֭תָּגֵלְנָה לְמַ֖עַן מִשְׁפָּטֶ֣יךָ יְהוָֽה׃
verses.transliteration: ṣî·yō·wn šā·mə·‘āh wat·tiś·maḥ bə·nō·wṯ yə·hū·ḏāh wat·tā·ḡê·lə·nāh lə·ma·‘an miš·pā·ṭe·ḵā Yah·weh
verses.literal: Zion hears and rejoices and the towns of Judah exult because of Your judgments O LORD

verses.original: כִּֽי־ אַתָּ֤ה יְהוָ֗ה עֶלְי֥וֹן עַל־ כָּל־ הָאָ֑רֶץ נַ֝עֲלֵ֗יתָ מְאֹ֥ד עַל־ כָּל־ אֱלֹהִֽים׃
verses.transliteration: kî- ’at·tāh Yah·weh ‘el·yō·wn ‘al- kāl- hā·’ā·reṣ na·‘ă·lê·ṯā mə·’ōḏ ‘al- kāl- ’ĕ·lō·hîm
verses.literal: For You O LORD are Most High over all the earth You are exalted far above all gods

verses.original: שִׂנְא֫וּ רָ֥ע אֹהֲבֵ֥י יְהוָ֗ה שֹׁ֭מֵר נַפְשׁ֣וֹת חֲסִידָ֑יו יַצִּילֵֽם׃ מִיַּ֥ד רְ֝שָׁעִ֗ים
verses.transliteration: śin·’ū rā‘ ’ō·hă·ḇê Yah·weh šō·mēr nap̄·šō·wṯ ḥă·sî·ḏāw yaṣ·ṣî·lêm mî·yaḏ rə·šā·‘îm
verses.literal: Hate evil O you who love the LORD He preserves the souls of His saints He delivers them from the hand of the wicked

verses.original: א֭וֹר זָרֻ֣עַ לַצַּדִּ֑יק שִׂמְחָֽה׃ וּֽלְיִשְׁרֵי־ לֵ֥ב
verses.literal: Light shines on the righteous gladness on the upright in heart

verses.original: שִׂמְח֣וּ בַּֽיהוָ֑ה צַ֭דִּיקִים וְ֝הוֹד֗וּ קָדְשֽׁוֹ׃ לְזֵ֣כֶר
verses.transliteration: śim·ḥū Yah·weh ṣad·dî·qîm wə·hō·w·ḏū qā·ḏə·šōw lə·zê·ḵer
verses.literal: Rejoice in the LORD you righteous ones and praise His holy name
